A_only_design_basis.note: A-only findings justify evaluating empty-current, unconditional one-window carry, and route-certified one-window carry. They do not select among them.

candidate_scope.carried_object: complete immutable frozen EPLR-V2 structured payload from anchor row: effective_count, selected source/transit/victim/path, decoder status, route certificate and selected route metadata
candidate_scope.only_allowed_anchor: same-run t-1, proven Raw-positive by fixed P2 gap history 1,1,0

L0_CURRENT_WINDOW_ONLY.description: Use the frozen current-window EPLR-V2 payload whenever P2_t=1. If Raw_t=0, current EPLR-V2 is INACTIVE_RAW, so payload remains empty.

L1_CARRY_LATEST_ACTIVE_ONE_WINDOW.description: If P2_t=1 and Raw_t=0, carry the complete already-frozen structured payload from t-1; otherwise use the current-window frozen EPLR-V2 payload.

L2_CARRY_LATEST_CERTIFIED_ONE_WINDOW.description: If P2_t=1 and Raw_t=0, carry the complete frozen payload from t-1 only when that t-1 payload is route-certified; otherwise keep the current INACTIVE_RAW empty payload. All non-gap rows use current EPLR-V2.

forbidden: B alignment evaluation before this protocol freeze
changing candidate definitions after B results

hard_invariants: P2 graph alarm bits identical for all candidates
candidate changes only P2=1 Raw=0 rows
no decoder rerun or new logits
any carried payload is byte-for-byte/array-for-array copied from same-run t-1 frozen output

ranking_among_eligible: lowest B false-positive-gap nonempty endpoint-payload rate
lowest B false-positive-gap route-certified payload rate
prefer route-certified-only carry over unconditional carry when all preceding metrics tie
fixed candidate order L0,L2,L1 as final deterministic tie-break
